name: One Good Pen
tagline: A pen that writes first time. Someone will still take it.
summary: One refillable ballpoint that writes first time. Black ink, Sky blue barrel. £9. Refills come in packs of two.
concept: A refillable ballpoint pen with a solid barrel and black ink. It starts first time and keeps going.
why_it_exists: Most pens skip, smudge or run dry when you need them. This one does not.
target_customer: People who sign, write lists or take notes and are tired of pens that do not work.

physical.form: A slim click-action ballpoint with a matte barrel and a clip.

features: It writes the first time you click it, with no scribbling to get it started.
The ink is black and the line is a neat 0.7 mm.
When the ink runs out you swap the refill, so the pen lasts for years.
The aluminium barrel feels solid in the hand and has a matte finish.
It clicks open and closed with one thumb, and the clip holds it on a pocket.
arrives: The pen comes in a brown card sleeve with no plastic. It travels in a small, flat parcel that fits through most letterboxes.
specs: Matte aluminium barrel, steel clip, metal ballpoint tip
Sky blue barrel with a pink clip
Click the tip in when not in use. Do not leave it in a hot car.
how_it_works: Click it and write. When it runs out, unscrew the barrel, swap the refill and screw it back.

accessories.name: Refills (2)
accessories.tagline: Two black refills for One Good Pen.
accessories.description: Two black ballpoint refills made for One Good Pen. Pull the old one out, push a new one in. Refills from other pens may not fit.
specs: Each refill 98 mm long, 4 mm across
Metal tube and tip, black ink
One Good Pen only. Refills from other pens may not fit.
Keep the tip capped in its card until you need it

packaging: A kraft card sleeve. No plastic.

warranty.summary: It has a 12-month warranty against faults in how it was made. Ink running out is not a fault. See Warranty.

care: Keep the cap-less tip clicked in when not in use.
Do not leave it in a hot car.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days if it is unused and in its box. See Returns.

page.headline: A pen that writes first time
page.intro: A pen that writes first time. Someone will still take it.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A refillable click ballpoint with black ink and a matte aluminium barrel, in Sky blue. £9.

sections.title: Refills
sections.body: A pack of two is £4. When the ink runs out, swap the refill and carry on.

faq.a: Yes. Refills come in a pack of two for £4.
Sky blue. There is one colour.
Yes, within 30 days, if it is unused and in its packaging.

steps: Click it twice to check the tip comes out.
Scribble on scrap paper to start the ink.
Unscrew the barrel and check the refill is seated.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Fit a new refill. If that fails too, open a support case.

steps: Wipe the tip and fit a new refill.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Open a support case if it keeps leaking.

photography_direction: One pen on its own. Matte barrel, visible clip. No paper, no handwriting.
